context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: Catch-22 is a novel about war, bureaucracy and the predicament of its airmen. A study guide’s statement about the effects of terror is an interpretation of that fiction, even when it sounds like an aphorism that might belong in the novel. Keeping a critic’s commentary separate from a novelist’s words is the central distinction in this attribution.
